assertions.subject: Bone sarcoma in adults
assertions.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for adults if an X‑ray suggests the possibility of bone sarcoma.

assertions.subject: Bone sarcoma in children and young people
assertions.quote: Consider a very urgent referral (for an appointment within 48 hours) for specialist assessment for children and young people if an X‑ray suggests the possibility of bone sarcoma.

assertions.subject: Bone sarcoma in children and young people
assertions.quote: Consider a very urgent, direct access X‑ray to assess for bone sarcoma in children and young people with unexplained bone swelling or pain.

assertions.subject: Soft tissue sarcoma in adults
assertions.predicate: unexplained lump that is increasing in size
assertions.quote: Consider an urgent, direct access ultrasound scan to assess for soft tissue sarcoma in adults with an unexplained lump that is increasing in size.

assertions.subject: Soft tissue sarcoma in adults
assertions.predicate: ultrasound scan findings suggestive of soft tissue sarcoma
assertions.quote: Consider a suspected cancer pathway referral for adults if they have ultrasound scan findings that are suggestive of soft tissue sarcoma or if ultrasound findings are uncertain and clinical concern persists.

assertions.subject: Soft tissue sarcoma in children and young people
assertions.predicate: unexplained lump that is increasing in size
assertions.quote: Consider a very urgent, direct access ultrasound scan to assess for soft tissue sarcoma in children and young people with an unexplained lump that is increasing in size.

assertions.subject: Soft tissue sarcoma in children and young people
assertions.predicate: ultrasound scan findings suggestive of soft tissue sarcoma
assertions.quote: Consider a very urgent referral (for an appointment within 48 hours) for children and young people if they have ultrasound scan findings that are suggestive of soft tissue sarcoma or if ultrasound findings are uncertain and clinical concern persists.
